subject: Eden Chang
intro: Hi, I'm Eden, a technical product manager.
I got my start in industrial design, metalwork and exhibition planning.
My work starts with everyday problems and turns them into product plans.

experience.name: What catches my attention
experience.description: A workaround people repeat every day, information they keep asking for, or a task that means switching between tools. I start by understanding what they need to accomplish and where the process gets in the way.

experience.name: What goes into the plan
experience.description: The main workflow is only part of it. I also work through permissions, missing information and interrupted steps, using requirements, UML and architecture diagrams to make the decisions clear enough to discuss.

experience.name: Why I make prototypes
experience.description: Some questions are easier to answer when there is something to try. Prototypes help me spot gaps and reconsider the scope; experience with system integration and AWS deployment informs the practical side of the plan.

strengths.name: Problem framing
strengths.description: Sort through scattered requirements to clarify what needs solving.

strengths.name: Empathy
strengths.description: Understand what people need before deciding what to build.

strengths.name: Cross-functional communication
strengths.description: Help users, business and engineering agree on a plan.

strengths.name: Structured thinking
strengths.description: Work out the workflows, priorities and next steps behind an idea.
